steps.text: Crack.
A thick layer of gravel has formed on the streets.
Most of the south side has been spared the effects of the Catastrophe, but at the peak of the storm, there was nowhere in Yumen where the sun could be seen.
Crack.
The lock is broken.
The furnace has been toppled, racks scattered everywhere, the yard littered with broken bricks and tiles.
The master of the house will never return to clean this up.
Yet the tree still stands.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Grandmaster.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Thank you for coming here to the Sword Forge.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: The sword has been found, but she insists on returning it to you personally.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: I need to talk to you.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Go ahead.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: It's been more than a decade since I was last here.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: It's like coming home, even though we're in the same city.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: About Mr. Meng...

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: There's no need to say anything.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: He knew it was wrong to put the whole city in danger. I reckon he had planned to atone for it from the beginning.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Still, my ill-considered actions have alienated the jianghu heroes of Yumen.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I will speak to my father and accept any discipline, once this crisis has passed.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: And I will indemnify any losses suffered by the Sword Forge, as well as the costs of any repairs.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Lord Exorcist is fair and just. He will give them a proper answer.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: However...

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: The events that transpired were sudden, and some misunderstanding is understandable. As for whether you lost your calm and stepped out of bounds... I will let you be your own judge.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I did what had to be done. My conscience is clear.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: —Mm.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I'm sure you understand that the Shanhaizhong are even more dangerous to Yan than the Feranmuts.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: The Feranmuts may be powerful, but we won the hunt a thousand years ago. Yan is even stronger now. There is nothing to fear.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: True. Times have changed.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: What is truly frightening is the shadow that had been cast on people's hearts since time primordial.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Heaven and earth, the moon and stars, wind and rain, the changing of the seasons... it is unfathomable, beyond our reckoning.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: The Feranmuts were the same to the people of the time.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Ignorance breeds fear, which becomes twisted into religion. To those madmen, we are the ones we are the outsiders. We are the traitors.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Religion is simply another kind of obsession.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: The Shanhaizhong's activities never waned, even after the Feranmuts faded from the public eye.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: In the past centuries, they have absorbed bandits, pirates, robbers, and other sorts of villains. They use the Feranmuts as a shadow to conceal their activities.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Sui Regulator records indicate that the Shanhaizhong have done unmeasurable harm in the name of the Feranmuts.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: The scale of their deeds is so widespread that complete elimination is impossible, and the vileness of their acts horrifying.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: They have started to reach out to the proxies of your kin. They were thankfully foiled by the timely intervention of the Sui Regulator.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: I doubt my siblings want anything to do with such 'disciples.'

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: However, the Sui's true form stirs from slumber, Yumen returns to its motherland, and the Shanhaizhong have infiltrated the city. It is a complex web, too complex to be a coincidence.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Do you mean...?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: All under Heaven is the offender's Go board. The Shanhaizhong may simply be a piece in his game.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: That's a serious accusation. Is it the Sui Regulator's official stance?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Or perhaps, the Shanhaizhong have already made contact with the Sui.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Therefore, the Sui Regulator sees this as the greatest Feranmut threat that Yan has faced in its history.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Tracking the sword, dealing with the criminals, hunting the Shanhaizhong... you are the youngest Candleholder of the Sui Regulator, and son of the Lord Exorcist of Yumen. In this matter, your burden has no equal.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: In a world of chaos, decisions of life and death must be swift and forceful as thunder.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Err on the side of going too far.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Better to be too harsh, than too lenient.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: That is what you think.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: ...Yes.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: There is a young Zuo Xuanliao in you.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: However, you seem to have forgotten Zuo Xuanliao's last instructions when he ordered you to do three things in three days.

steps.name: Zuo Xuanliao
steps.text: Keep this secret, and do not disturb the people.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: What was the ultimate goal of the imperial court when the Sui Regulator was established to deal with Feranmut matters?

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Why has Yumen returned to the motherland, its survival at stake?

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: It's for the people in this city right now. The people whom you brought back to the camp.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: ...For all the people.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Never forget what all you do is for.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Maybe you were right in this instance, but a position of authority and holding the power to make decisions also means holding the power to kill or harm. Some mistakes can never be undone.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Though it shouldn't have been me to tell you all this.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Thank you for your guidance, Grandmaster.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: The Catastrophe rages on. Go and help.

steps.name: Anxious Shanhaizhong Member
steps.text: Boss, everybody, get in here.

steps.name: Anxious Shanhaizhong Member
steps.text: This out-of-the-way alley is a blind spot in the Patrol Battalion's search routes. We're safe here for now.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Ringleader
steps.text: Finally, a breather... is this all the men we have left?

steps.name: Anxious Shanhaizhong Member
steps.text: We lost the rest on the street.

steps.name: Anxious Shanhaizhong Member
steps.text: The Yumen soldiers moved much faster than expected, setting up watch around Catastrophe defenses and key roads in a very short time.

steps.name: Anxious Shanhaizhong Member
steps.text: And those guards and brawlers who appeared out of nowhere. Cao, they were tough...

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Ringleader
steps.text: What about the Di beast we sent out?

steps.name: Anxious Shanhaizhong Member
steps.text: None returned.

steps.name: Anxious Shanhaizhong Member
steps.text: The other groups are probably no better off. If they were captured alive...

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Ringleader
steps.text: A rabble of greedy crooks who were recruited to not leave a trail to begin with. They won't give away anything important.

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Ringleader
steps.text: We've done what we came for. Let's go while we still have the Catastrophe, before Yumen can cut off our escape.

steps.name: Anxious Shanhaizhong Member
steps.text: By the way... where's the Master?

steps.name: Anxious Shanhaizhong Member
steps.text: Where is she at this crucial time?

steps.name: Shanhaizhong Ringleader
steps.text: She's...

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: I took your sword. Now I'm giving it back.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Since you've returned it, I'll say you borrowed it.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: I want to ask you a few questions. I'll only give it back after you've answered.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: I know you're much stronger than I am, but don't try to take it by force.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Very well. Ask.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: Why don't you look anxious at all? Don't you care about the sword?

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: A worldly possession. One that cannot be easily discarded.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: I wouldn't say I don't care.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: Either you care about it or not.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: Shifu was right. The way that you beat around the bush can be annoying.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: The one who said that...

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: Is the sword called 'Chongyue?'

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: 'Shuo.'

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Chongyue is my name.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: Shifu often talked about this sword.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: But maybe it's not just the sword that she wanted to see.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: For the last couple of days, I've been thinking, is this Shifu's home?
Shifu taught us how to fight, taught us knowledge from the nomadic cities.
How to build sturdier houses to stand against the sandstorms, and how to listen to the pulse of the land in order to plant crops and dig for water, even in the barrens.
The nomadic city that Shifu talked about was tall and strong. I saw how the people turned back even an all-consuming Catastrophe, when they stood together with each other.
Everyone should have a place to call home.
If home lets us rest without fear of disaster or having to chase the seasons...

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: Then why did Shifu leave twenty years ago?
The man does not answer.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: She was very ill, but she taught you kung fu?

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: We Anasa are gifted with strong bodies. Shifu said that when one has a home, one must learn to protect it.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: We learned quickly, so that Shifu would not have to demonstrate over and over again with her sickly body.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: My people thought about taking her away from the barrens to get treatment.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: Shifu always answered, 'But how draining would the journey be? I would rather see how the Liedaozi I taught you to brew is coming along.'

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: Did you ever find a doctor?
The man shakes his head.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Not in the places I looked. I was going to look elsewhere, when I received an urgent message from Yumen.
The Shanhaizhong were wreaking havoc in Yumen. They asked me to return as soon as possible.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: So Shifu's illness could not have been treated, even if she never left.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: ...Yes.
Shifu said that the cycle of life and death is something everyone goes through.
A little longer or shorter doesn't change anything.
What really separates us is the 'age' between life and death, and even more cruel 'illness.'
What can be seen but cannot be helped merely makes one troubled.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: The first batch of Liedaozi was finished just before Shifu passed away. She drank it with us and heard us sing a song with no name.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: It was an old song that the Anasa sang for our dead kin to put their souls to rest. Shifu asked what point there is in singing a song for her, if she can't hear it?

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: 'Let me hear it while I still can.'

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Good. She didn't die alone.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: I was eating at the inn yesterday and saw that people were preparing to see you off.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Did you...?

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: Are you leaving?

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: It's been more than a hundred years. It's time to go.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: You've been here so long. Isn't this your home?

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Many people's homes are somewhere else in Yan, but they stay here to protect this city.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: But where it's going, I can't go with it.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: Would you have gone to look for Shifu, if she was still alive?
The spring comes and goes, leaving the autumn heart despondent.
Such is mortality.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: You are like the Anasa.
Anasa. Those without roots.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: (In ancient Sarkaz) ...Maybe.
The words and intonation are indistinguishable from a native.
The Anasa girl knows, however, that he is not one of her kind.
He has simply gone to many places and met many people.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: Forget it. Here's your sword. I have nothing more to ask.
The man never answered any of the questions.
He neither answered, nor dodged them.
The Anasa suddenly understands how her shifu must have felt when she left.

steps.name: Jieyun
steps.text: I'm going home.
The Anasa girl falls to the ground.
She has passed out from sheer exhaustion.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Her injuries...

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: She pulled the sword...
The ancient sword leaves its sheath.
It looks no different, save for the vestige of an old friend, almost gone now.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: The medium is the jade on her forehead...

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: She used to wear it, saying that it calmed her mind and warded off evil...
I see.
A move decades in the making.
But a poor one, if the sword was the only goal.
...The one in the city?
He had his eye on one corner of the board, ignoring the other.
Hah.
So this is what it is...
This is how you have fallen...
How amusing.
I want to see how you swallow it...
The shame.
'Sui?'

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: First the Lord Exorcist's tent, now the central room of Yumen's inner city. Have you never been taught that it is rude to come uninvited?
You?
You got your sword back.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Just now.
Looks like he has discovered your secret.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: So you have met my brother...
You separate that part that belonged to It and sealed it away, while he wants to take its place.
The attitude with which the two of you treat It, what you are doing, is bold, and interesting.
But ultimately foolish and pointless.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Perhaps no more than what you are doing right now.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: You're not here for the Catastrophe, for the city, or for what I hold in my hands right now.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: You made all this mess just to ask for directions.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: You wanted to know where the Sui is.
How dare you compare those things to It?
You are slow on the uptake.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: It slipped my mind as to who would be so interested in It, other than the imperial court and my siblings.
You have forgotten what you used to be.

a.text: Only a Feranmut would seek out another.

steps.name: Chongyue?
steps.text: Long time.

steps.name: Chongyue?
steps.text: No see.
An utterance with a million connotations behind it.
Poignant lament, cold sarcasm, or seething anger, a thousand emotions exploded at once, then dissipated.
They dig wounds in the depths of memories immemorial.
In time beyond reckoning, It and It, They, engaged in dialogue form afar as such.

a.text: I came back to this land to settle our debts.
But what right does a fragment sealed in a trinket have to engage in dialogue with me?
I want to see you as who you truly are.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: There's something I'm curious about.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: You fled after the hunt, not to be heard from all these years. Why have you chosen to return to Yan at this time?

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: It was my brother who awakened you...

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: As for the Shanhaizhong that appeared with you...
They? Hah.
Just made some company on the way.
I encountered them in the desert. I shared the forming Catastrophe that I saw, and made a little show of power.
They were surprised that someone could know the Feranmuts so well. They were convinced that I was a herald of the Feranmut.
Some are pretentious, some sincere, but all strive to prove their faith to me, worshipping bits and pieces that they claim to have come from the Feranmuts.
They curse their own kind and imagine overthrowing all order. They look down on mankind, utter meaningless words, and implore me to communicate their faith.
Little do they know that the object of their faith itself stands before them.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: If your encounter with the Shanhaizhong was by chance, and you had intended to sneak into the central room all along, in order to lock on to the Sui's location through Yumen's navigational coordinates...

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Why are the Shanhaizhong here?

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: To destroy Yumen? Not very likely.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Until they met you, they didn't know there would be a timely Catastrophe in Yumen's path.
I'm not interested in mankind's petty machinations.
I just needed some hands to cause chaos.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: In human terms, you manipulated your followers.
And?
To become infected with hysteria and start thinking about one's own existence, even denying it.
Only slightly more amusing than those who remain foolish, from their first moments to their last.
That is to say, not very amusing.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: What would they think, if they knew their god thought so little of them?
Since when have we needed the faith of such puny beings?
Except for fools like the Sui.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Leaving so soon?
I spared some time for you only because you are Its fragment.
I've already wasted too much time.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: I should have realized the other day when we fought. The scent of flowers and the sight of spring were too real to be achieved by Originium Arts.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Sui Regulator records speak of a beast by the name of Ya, who cuts away the seasons and holds them at its bosom.
You have Its memory, yet you dare call me in the human way!
What a disciple name, just like 'Sui!'
Cuts away the seasons?
Humans measure time in such silly ways.
It is no illusion. An illusion cannot be so real.
It ceases to exist in some other fleeting time.
It exists in this never-ending present.
Time has stopped.
Eight thousand years of spring, eight thousand years of autumn.
A maze that has no ending.
Time has not stopped.
A lone boat on a river, each one standing on one end.
A ripple spreads from the end of the boat.

steps.name: Ya
steps.text: You're trying to make me stay?

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: You demonstrate incredible mastery of space, but I must make you stay.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Even if I can't.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: I would have left Yumen by now, if things had gone according to plan.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: For you, neither Catastrophe nor Yumen can compare in importance to the Sui.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: For me, however, there is nothing that I care less about than the Sui.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: For you, all that is happening outside is a fleeting cloud.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: For me, it is the damaged walls, broken houses, suffering soldiers and civilians.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: And... one old friend who died with regret.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: The Catastrophe has not passed. They do not even know that you exist.

steps.name: Chongyue
steps.text: Someone must make a stand for Yumen.
I guess there's no one but me to do it.
